title: Narrative Engine plugin manifest
description: The description of one plugin version: the schema of its content, the items it exports and the rules that derive its dynamic links.

manifest.description: The version of the manifest format.

schema.description: The JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) of an instance's content. Its default is the content of a new instance, and every title and description is a translation key.

exports.description: The lists of linkable items an instance exposes, by export name. A link addresses an item as `<export>/<id>`, so a name holds no slash.

links.description: The rules that derive dynamic links from the content of an instance, by relationship.

name.description: The translation key of the export's display name.

select.description: The path to the exported items in the content.

id.description: The JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the identifier inside each item.

label.description: The JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the label inside each item.

rule.description: A rule of the one kind, `sequence`. Its steps are ordered as the arrays of the content hold them, and it derives a link from each step and each part to each other one. The distance of a link is the position of its destination's step minus the position of its source's step.

select.description: The path to the steps in the content. Its `[*]` reaches the items of an array alone: an object keeps its members in no order.

id.description: The JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the identifier inside each step.

target.description: The name the steps are addressed under: a step is `<target>/<step ID>`. Under the name of an export, the steps are that export's items, selected with its `select` and its `id`.

parts.description: The parts of a step, each addressed `<target>/<step ID>/<part ID>`.

select.description: The path to the parts, from their step.

id.description: The JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the identifier inside each part.

name.description: The first segment of an address, which holds no slash.

path.description: `$`, then member names and `[*]`: a subset of JSONPath (RFC 9535).
